theme_strategy: The application MUST support TWO switchable themes (Modern Light and Health/Emergency). Implement a toggle/switcher in the UI that changes a data attribute on the HTML tag (e.g., data-theme='emergency' vs default).

typography.strategy: Swiss Brutalist meets Old Money Tech. Professional, data-oriented, maximum legibility.

default_modern_light.description: White background with navy blue (lacivert) accents. Clean, professional.

emergency_theme.description: Health/Emergency theme with red accents. Urgency, medical focus.

calendar_status.dont_want_shift: bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 border-yellow-200 (Yellow for Nobet Istemiyor)

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid ONLY. No glassmorphism. Medical data must be sharp, clear, and high contrast without refraction or blur.
visual_enhancers.borders: Crisp 1px borders on cards (border-border). No heavy drop shadows. Use subtle shadow-sm for elevation.
visual_enhancers.radius: Rounded-md (6px) or rounded-lg (8px). Keep it sharp and technical, not overly bubbly.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_bento: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6. Summary cards take col-span-1. Main tables/charts take col-span-2 or col-span-3.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous internal padding for reading clarity (p-6 on cards). Tight gap on data tables.
grids_and_layouts.mobile_first: Must be highly touch-optimized. Navigation moves to a bottom bar or a clean hamburger sidebar. Tables MUST use horizontal scroll (overflow-x-auto) on mobile.

components.dashboard_cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border. Contains Total Staff, Selected Month, Shifts Generated, Rule Violations. Add lucide-icons.
components.personnel_table: Dense Shadcn Table. Use IBM Plex Sans. Include column for Roles (Sağlıkçı, Sürücü, Sağlıkçı+Sürücü). Right-align numeric data. Striped rows on hover.
components.calendar_requests: A robust full-month grid. MUST support multi-select (click and drag or tap multiple). Minimum 44px touch targets for mobile. Highlight dates with Green (Yearly Leave) or Yellow (Don't want shift).
components.shift_list_table: Day-by-day table showing Date, Day, 2 Medics + 2 Drivers (or 1x 24h driver). Needs 'Edit' button on each row opening a manual assignment modal. Warning toast/badge if rules are violated (e.g. consecutive shifts without rest).
components.stats_charts: Use Recharts (BarChart for Shift hours/Weekends balance). Solid colors from primary/secondary CSS vars.
components.toast_notifications: Use Sonner. Crucial for algorithm feedback. Slide in from bottom right.
components.export_actions: Primary/Outline buttons for Excel and PDF. Placed in a sticky header on the shift list.

motion.strategy: Minimal and snappy. Medical dashboards shouldn't wait for animations.
motion.hover: Subtle -translate-y-[1px] on cards, background color shifts on buttons.
motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out for interactive elements. NEVER transition: all.

print_styles.instructions: MUST include a print stylesheet (@media print). Hide sidebar/navigation, remove shadows, set backgrounds to white, borders to solid black. Ensure the Shift List Table fits on A4 paper.

accessibility.touch_targets: Min 44x44px for calendar days and action buttons.
accessibility.focus: focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2. Never rely solely on color for state.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over primary buttons passes WCAG AA.

icons_and_media.usage: Only use images for mock personnel avatars in the table or dashboard. Otherwise, rely purely on typography and layout.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use Manrope and IBM Plex Sans.
Implement the Theme Switcher. Create a context/store that toggles a 'data-theme' attribute on the document body between 'light' and 'emergency'.
Use Shadcn UI for Table, Button, Dialog, Select, Sonner.
The Calendar component must be highly customized to support multi-select drag/tap for leaves, color-coded per the JSON.
Implement Recharts for the Statistics page.
For the 'Aylık Nöbet Listesi', include visual indicators (badges or red text) if a manually edited shift violates a rule.
Ensure 'data-testid' is added to all interactive elements for robust testing.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds on headers or overlays. Use solid bg-background.
Use standard pure HTML/Tailwind structures where Shadcn is too rigid for the dashboard layout.
Generate dummy data based on Turkish names and '112 Acil' roles (Sağlıkçı, Sürücü, Sağlıkçı+Sürücü) to demonstrate the algorithm.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through z-index and borders, NOT shadows or glassmorphism (especially for this medical dashboard).
Do not add text-align: center to the root App container.
Use pill-shaped or sharp buttons based on the defined radius.
Never use Emoji characters as icons; use lucide-react.
Include hover states and micro-interactions for all interactive elements.
If a component needs a date picker, use Shadcn calendar.
